## Progress

- Merged [PR #34](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/34): `tools/synthetic-data-generator` migrates and seeds "Iyer Family Clinic (synthetic)" (Adyar) with one membership per role, and "Al Noor Family Clinic (synthetic)" with `--uae`; fixed ids make re-seeding idempotent; refuses anything but Development/Staging/Test; Testcontainers tests, mutation-checked
- Left: seed users and sign-in with MFA (MDV-P0-011), patient records once the patient table exists, seeding staging on deploy and listing seed accounts in the R0 package (needs MDV-P0-006)

## Description

tools/synthetic-data-generator and packages/test-fixtures produce the synthetic cast (Iyer Family Clinic, Dr. Arjun Rao, A. Joseph, S. Thomas RN, Priya N., Meera Iyer, Deepak Nair; a UAE tenant Al Noor Family Clinic with Dr. Omar Haddad and Fatima Al Mansoori) with users for every role. Staging is seeded on deploy; data is visibly marked SYNTHETIC.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Staging has a seeded India tenant with one user per role (and a UAE tenant if parameters enabled) able to sign in with MFA.
- [ ] **AC2.** All seeded records carry a synthetic marker and use invalid-by-construction identifiers (e.g. ABHA/EID numbers that fail real checksums).
- [ ] **AC3.** Re-seeding is idempotent and never runs against production (guarded by environment check + test).
- [ ] **AC4.** The staging URL and seed accounts are listed in the R0 delivery package (secrets shared out of band).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
